Over a Dozen Companies Plan IPOs Worth ₹25,000 Crore Next Month

More than 12 companies, including Zepto and Shiprocket, are planning to launch their Initial Public Offerings (IPOs) next month. These upcoming share sales are collectively expected to raise over ₹25,000 crore. This indicates a significant rush of companies seeking to go public in the near future.
